statements.statement: The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are concerning for potential arrhythmia
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
